prompt: A thin shaft of morning light crosses a square amber-glass perfume bottle with a flat black cap and a small ivory label, standing on warm limestone. The light slides slowly across the glass until the right edge glows.

In a close overhead view a strip of bergamot peel curls beside the same square amber bottle on pale stone. A single droplet forms on the peel and falls. Keep the flat black cap and ivory label in place.

A hand lifts the flat black cap straight up from the square amber bottle and presses the black atomizer once. A fine plume hangs in the window light and drifts to the left. Frame in profile with the ivory label visible.

Return to the square amber bottle with its flat black cap seated and ivory label facing forward. Push in slowly across pale limestone until the bottle fills the center of the frame. Hold on the last reflection.
